prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that your truck is a rental. Respond to the committee.
response:
*adjusts collar, leans into microphone*

Mr. Chairman, distinguished members of the committee, I come before you today of my own free will to address these scurrilous and defamatory accusations.

The allegation that my truck is a rental is not only false — it is an insult to everything I stand for. That F-150 has been in my possession for eleven years. Eleven years, sir! I have the maintenance records. I have the original title. I have a glove box full of Wendy's napkins that no rental agency would tolerate. I did not simply *acquire* that truck bed rust — I *earned* it.

*produces documents*

I would like to enter into the record: Exhibit A, a photograph of me changing my own oil in 2016. Exhibit B, the trailer hitch I installed myself, which — I will note for the committee — has hauled mulch on *no fewer* than fourteen occasions.

Furthermore, I categorically deny the whisper campaign suggesting my ribs are "fall-off-the-bone" because I boiled them first. I have never boiled a rib in my life. I am, and have always been, a low-and-slow man. 225 degrees. Post oak. I welcome any inspection of my smoker, which I built from a repurposed propane tank with my own two hands.

Now, if the committee wishes to discuss the gentleman two seats down — the one who brought *store-bought potato salad* in a hand-labeled Tupperware to the Fourth of July gathering — I am prepared to name names.

I yield the remainder of my time, but not my dignity.
